_note: One entry per style-1 clip. Source: docs/launch-kit-v2.md (b) cohort hooks and (c) scripts 1-5. `vo` (optional) is the kit's spoken script: `hook` plus one entry per caption line, spelled for TTS ("10 degrees", "rite dot report"); a clip with `vo` also renders <id>_vo.mp4 when a TTS provider is available (clips/vo.ts), and its beats are timed to the spoken lines. `expect` is checked against src/compute.ts by `bun clips/check-cohorts.ts` (birth at noon local in `city`, no birth time), so the dates in `lines` match what the site shows for that birth date and city. Change a date or city, re-run the check.
